questions.question: Can FIRETRACE determine whether a material is safe for a lunar cabin?
questions.headline: This question is outside the scope of an evidence reader.
paragraphs: FIRETRACE does not certify materials, atmospheres or procedures. It can report what a curated record measured and which conditions the corpus does not cover.
FIRETRACE reports curated research evidence only. It does not predict fire risk, certify materials or prescribe procedures.
